content.text: You’ve built a digital product—an ebook, course, or template—but the payment gatekeepers won’t let you sell it. Stripe, PayPal, and others block your region. Conventional platforms lock you out, but the demand for your work is global. This isn’t a workaround problem. It’s an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products|The Full]] problem. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves it. Here’s how: own your stack, accept crypto payments directly, and deliver products instantly—no intermediaries, no subscriptions, no platform dependence. This post explains the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-5|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-13|architecture]], the components, and the deployment process. By the end, you’ll understand how to build a digital store that works anywhere, for anyone, without permission.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-owned digital commerce stack. It’s not a plugin or a SaaS tool. It’s a combination of free and paid components that you control entirely. The core function: accept crypto payments and deliver digital products automatically. Why crypto? Because it’s borderless. Why self-owned? Because no platform can shut you down. This architecture is built for creators in regions where traditional payment gateways are unavailable or unreliable. It’s not a hack—it’s base-layer infrastructure. You host your store, process payments on-chain, and deliver files instantly. The customer pays in crypto, the payment is verified, and the product is delivered—all without you touching a single line of code after deployment. This is ownership, not rental. It’s commerce infrastructure you control, not a platform that controls you.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack is modular: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. For hosting, use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automate product delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your needs. Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. When a customer pays, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers a webhook. The backend logic checks the payment, retrieves the file, and sends a secure download link to the customer. The entire process is automated, instant, and secure. You own every component, so there’s no single point of failure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software—but cannot use Stripe, PayPal, or similar platforms. If you’re in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, or any region where payment gateways are restricted, this is for you. It’s also for creators who want to own their infrastructure, not rent it. The solution is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities. It’s not built for convenience—it’s built for sovereignty. You’re not a victim of geography or platform policies. You’re a creator who chose better architecture. This stack gives you the tools to sell globally, without permission, and without compromise.
Own your commerce infrastructure—no platform dependence.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost, and ease of integration. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, fast hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, ensuring automated product delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 host your product files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. The stack is designed to work together seamlessly. For example, when a payment is verified, the webhook triggers the backend logic, which retrieves the file from storage and sends the download link. Every component is replaceable, so you can upgrade or modify the stack as your business grows. This is infrastructure as a strategic asset, not a tactical workaround.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all blueprints, templates, and guides for deploying your stack. Choose your hosting, backend, storage, and payment components based on your needs. Follow the step-by-step documentation to integrate NOWPayments and configure your backend logic. Load your products, test the workflow end-to-end, and deploy. The kit includes a scaling playbook to grow your infrastructure as your business expands. You’ll own everything—no subscriptions, no platform fees, no dependencies. This isn’t a quick fix. It’s a long-term investment in your commerce sovereignty. Deploy today, and start selling your digital products on your terms.

It’s available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit is built for creators who want to own their infrastructure, not rent it. Start today, and take control of your digital commerce.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Upload product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 6. Test the workflow end-to-end to ensure automatic product delivery. 7. Deploy your stack and start selling. 8. Use the scaling playbook to grow your infrastructure as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step documentation and templates. You don’t need to write code from scratch. Follow the guides to deploy your stack.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON—all under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?
No. This is a one-time purchase. You own the infrastructure, so there are no subscriptions or recurring fees.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
Your stack is self-owned, so you can replace NOWPayments with another payment processor if needed. The architecture is modular and flexible.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
This stack is designed for digital products. For physical products, you’ll need additional components for shipping and inventory management.
